data.content_ref: inline:The bound c_{n-1} + c_n is incorrect; the standard Kozen-Zaks bound is c_1 + c_2 (largest plus second-largest coin), not the sum of the two smallest. Since c_n = 1, the claimed bound is c_{n-1} + 1, which can be far smaller than c_1 + c_2. The algorithm would miss counterexamples above this too-small bound, making it incorrect.
